generic_name: Thuja Occidentalis, Mezereum, Silicea, Calcarea Carbonica, Morbillinum, Parotidinum, Pertussinum, Rubella Nosode, Tetanus Toxin, Carcinosin, Antimonium Crudum, Ledum Palustre, Thimerosal, Poliomyelitis Nosode (Homeopathic Combination)
brand_names: No widely recognized FDA-approved brand names
purpose: This is a combination homeopathic preparation containing multiple highly diluted substances. It is sometimes marketed to support immune health or as an alternative approach following vaccination. However, it is very important to know that there is no scientific evidence these ingredients provide any medical benefit, and they are NOT approved by the FDA to treat, prevent, or cure any disease.
how_it_works: Homeopathic theory suggests that extremely diluted substances can stimulate the body's natural healing. However, modern science does not support this theory, and at the extreme dilutions used in homeopathy, none of the original substances are likely to remain. There is no proven biological mechanism by which these preparations work.
common_side_effects: Homeopathic products are so diluted that direct toxic side effects are generally unlikely. However, the real risk is using these products instead of proven medical treatments, which can lead to serious harm from untreated or preventable illness.
warnings: WARNING: This preparation contains 'Thimerosal' and 'nosodes' sometimes falsely promoted as alternatives to vaccines. Vaccines are safe, proven, and life-saving. Do NOT use homeopathic products as a replacement for real vaccines or prescribed medications. Some ingredients like Thuja, Mezereum, and Ledum in undiluted forms are toxic plants. Always talk to your real doctor before using any homeopathic product. The FDA has warned consumers about unapproved homeopathic products.
typical_dosing: Dosing varies widely depending on the specific product and manufacturer, as these are not standardized medications. Because there is no proven benefit, no safe or effective dose can be recommended. Please consult a licensed healthcare provider before using this or any homeopathic preparation.
